body.title: Add dedicated security reviews
body.problem: Insrc's general review flow does not give developers a dedicated assessment of vulnerabilities or a separately chosen security reviewer model. It also lacks a defined way to check resolved dependencies against current advisories while keeping repository and credential access bounded, making it hard to distinguish verified findings from gaps in coverage.

summary.prose: Developers can request a dedicated assessment of code and dependency vulnerabilities. Each report identifies the security model, evidence, and limits of the assessment. The data-model extension points this review needs -- SecurityFinding, SecurityLocator, the EvidenceProvider registry, VerificationReceipt, and their JSON Schema transformers -- are already built (standalone Story add-securityfinding-capability-family-delegates-framing, epicHash 779e9a08142cb057, s1, BUILD approved); this Epic's Stories add the model selection, isolated execution, advisory fetching, and reporting logic that populate those types, not a redesign of the types themselves.

nonGoals.text: General code quality review and automatic remediation
nonGoals.rationale: This workflow is scoped to security assessment.

nonGoals.text: Redesigning the SecurityFinding / SecurityLocator / EvidenceProvider / VerificationReceipt data model
nonGoals.rationale: Already built as extension-point types by the standalone Story add-securityfinding-capability-family-delegates-framing (epicHash 779e9a08142cb057, s1, BUILD approved: src/workflow/review-round/security-finding.ts, security-locator.ts, evidence-provider.ts, receipt-record.ts, security-schema.ts). This Epic's Stories build on those types; an insrc_analyze_step capability-discovery run against src/workflow/review-round found zero clear-match and only data-shape partial-matches for a real security-review execution pass, confirming no execution logic exists yet to duplicate.

constraints.text: Cloud inference uses the installed CLI provider. Embeddings and repository stores follow the existing local-first rules.
Use an explicitly selected security model alongside existing model selections. Keep repository access read-only and constrain advisory egress to the information required for lookup.

stories.title: Configure a dedicated security model
stories.userValue: Select and audit the reviewer model independently of core, mid, and cheap.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a configured security model is available
acceptanceCriteria.then: it runs with that model and records its identity. If unavailable, it reports the blocker without a silent fallback.

stories.title: Isolate reviewer access and fetch dependency advisories
stories.userValue: Check current dependency advisories while protecting repository data and local credentials, implementing the EvidenceProvider registry's dependency-sbom category (already typed in evidence-provider.ts) by wiring the existing pkg_audit tool rather than building a new advisory fetcher.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a read-only review scope and resolved dependencies
acceptanceCriteria.then: lookups send only approved package coordinates through controlled egress, and unavailable sources or unresolved dependencies remain explicit gaps, implemented as the EvidenceProvider registry's dependency-sbom category wired to the existing pkg_audit tool (src/daemon/tools/builtins/pkg/index.ts), not a new fetcher.

stories.title: Run and report a security-only review
stories.userValue: Request a review of vulnerabilities with actionable evidence, populating the already-typed SecurityFinding/SecurityEvidence/VerificationReceipt shapes rather than redefining them.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a selected repository scope and revision
acceptanceCriteria.when: a user requests a security review
acceptanceCriteria.then: the report separates code findings, confirmed affected dependencies, and unverified coverage, with severity, evidence, prerequisites, and remediation, populating the existing SecurityFinding (security-finding.ts) and VerificationReceipt (receipt-record.ts) shapes rather than defining new ones.

requirements.statement: Run a separate security-only review using a specified security model and record the effective model in the report.
Assess relevant code vulnerabilities and resolve direct and transitive dependency advisory matches where exact versions are available.
Give findings evidence, severity, exploit prerequisites, and remediation guidance. Report unresolved versions, missing evidence and unavailable advisory sources explicitly.

citations.ref: User request for dedicated security reviews
